name: Help Center
storyline: Kattaa's friends' unruly behavior embarrasses her, compelling her to establish a community "help" group with little to no apparent purpose to anyone other than herself.
summary:
A furry RPG. The player controls an ornery cat named Kattaa. Kattaa's friends' unruly behavior embarrasses her, compelling her to establish a community "help" group with little to no apparent purpose to anyone other than herself. All graphics and some music are original to the game.

Cast of characters includes Kattaa's fox girlfriend, a strange jungle pet, a winged dog who really loves basketball, Kattaa's girlfriend's awful roommate, said roommate's online romantic interest who is nothing he says he is, an oddball red panda who lives in the spooky forest, an old college friend who has become a very successful cow in the business world, and an unsociable dingo whose many adopted sheep siblings save the player's progress.

The game takes around 30 to 50 minutes to complete.
